content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ITI Narayanpur Guest Lecturer (Drone Technician) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://narayanpur.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 09-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ITI Narayanpur Guest Lecturer (Drone Technician) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ITI Narayanpur Guest Lecturer (Drone Technician) recruitment is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Guest Lecturer (Drone Technician). This role is for a 6-month course.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Guest Lecturer (Drone Technician).

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Degree/Diploma in a relevant Engineering field or as per the rules specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ITI Narayanpur located?
faq.answer: ITI Narayanpur is located in Narayanpur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 494661.

faq.question: Q9. What are the selection process steps?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification and the creation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of ITI Narayanpur, which is https://narayanpur.gov.in.
